spec.purpose: Trace unchanged actual entry decisions; classify causal short-window flow and final decision origins. No rule tuning or entry modification.
spec.flowDefinition: Sign of actual log-return over each of 5/10/20 seconds; classify aligned/opposed only when all are nonzero and agree. Historical quote at/before each target must be within 2500ms.
caveats: Already inspected windows from one external Forex trading day, not live broker/OTC results.
Quote-only video has no native candle history.
The user screenshots do not supply the actual pre-entry quote stream; this does not reconstruct their entries.

Group statistics describe the original entry stream. They are not a replay of a filtered strategy: removing entries changes subsequent admission times. Subgroup loss streaks are within that subgroup, not consecutive losses in the full live stream.
